card.name: The word more before frequent
card.fires_on: The word "more" right before "frequent" (as in monitoring or doses), in dosing and monitoring instructions. Weaker on a few spots where a dosing interval or schedule word comes next.

modes.label: more before frequent
modes.description: The word "more" after consider/or/and, where "frequent" is expected next.
modes.example: Monitor platelet counts at least monthly during treatment with NINLARO. Consider<< more>> frequent monitoring during the first three cycles.

modes.label: Partway through drug or interval words
modes.description: Inside a drug name or just before an interval, where timing like "every 8 hours" follows.
modes.example: P. aeruginosa , a dose of 20 mg/kg (or 1 gram for pediatric patients weighing over 50 kg) every<< >>8 hours is recommended.
